question: Compare how Schwab and Raymond James describe their value proposition to independent advisors.
reasoning_content:
I need to answer sub-question a1.SCHW: How Schwab describes its value proposition to independent advisors.

Let me identify the relevant passages that describe Schwab's value proposition to independent advisors.

Key passages:
- SCHW-TR-2026Q3#10: "We have built our adviser business around helping independent advisers grow, compete and succeed... a platform that brings together custody, trading, banking and lending capabilities, technology and dedicated service and support."
- SCHW-10K-2025#23: "dedicated to helping RIAs grow, compete, and succeed in serving their clients."
- SCHW-DECK-2026-investor-day#35: "The leading RIA support ecosystem to help advisors serve their clients, providing wealth tools, investment / lending products, & technology in addition to custody & service"
- SCHW-TR-2026Q1#48: "our value proposition to advisers has never been stronger"
- SCHW-DECK-2026Q3#21: "A differentiated, full-service platform" - Scale & Reputation, Breadth Beyond Custody, Operational Excellence, Dedicated Service & Support
- SCHW-TR-2025Q4#45: "it's hard for other firms to compete with our size, scale, and the breadth and strength of our capabilities"
- SCHW-TR-2026Q3#52: "Our capabilities are hard to match in terms of the service we provide, the breadth of capabilities..."
- SCHW-TRADE-2026-10-28-WM-01#0: "Our job and our role is to provide a platform and a support ecosystem that helps you support your clients and helps your firm thrive."
- SCHW-TRADE-2026-08-26-WM-01#1: "Schwab is focused on creating long-term value and access for advisors... Few firms can bring together custody, trading, banking, lending, wealth management, workplace and retail investing at Schwab's scale and value - with the best client service"

cells.label: fact

items.text: Schwab describes its advisor business as built around helping independent advisors grow, compete and succeed, with a platform combining custody, trading, banking and lending, technology, and dedicated service and support.
items.quote: We have built our adviser business around helping independent advisers grow, compete and succeed. Today, we serve more than 16,000 firms... with a platform that brings together custody, trading, banking and lending capabilities, technology and dedicated service and support.

items.text: Schwab states its Advisor Services segment maintains competitive position through sales, support, technology and business consulting teams dedicated to helping RIAs grow, compete and succeed.
items.quote: Management believes that we can maintain our competitive position primarily through the efforts of our sales, support, technology, and business consulting teams, which are dedicated to helping RIAs grow, compete, and succeed in serving their clients.

items.text: Schwab describes itself as the leading RIA support ecosystem to help advisors serve their clients, providing wealth tools, investment/lending products and technology in addition to custody and service.
items.quote: The leading RIA support ecosystem to help advisors serve their clients, providing wealth tools, investment / lending products, & technology in addition to custody & service

items.text: Schwab describes its value proposition to advisors as having never been stronger, citing added lending capabilities including structured asset lending.
items.quote: And so our value proposition to advisers has never been stronger.

items.text: Schwab describes its differentiated, full-service platform for advisors as combining scale and reputation, breadth beyond custody, operational excellence, and dedicated service and support.
items.quote: Scale & Reputation 1 2 Breadth Beyond Custody 3 Operational Excellence Dedicated Service & Support 4

items.text: Schwab states it is hard for other firms to compete with its size, scale, and the breadth and strength of its capabilities across custody, consulting and advice, and product capabilities.
items.quote: I think it's hard for other firms to compete with our size, scale, and the breadth and strength of our capabilities, whether it's the custody offering... whether it's the consulting and advice and expertise that we bring, the support we bring to help them in their drive to independence.

items.text: Schwab states its capabilities are hard to match in terms of service, breadth of capabilities, banking and lending alongside custody, AI innovations, and advice and consulting support.
items.quote: Our capabilities are hard to match in terms of the service we provide, the breadth of capabilities that we provide, our banking and lending capabilities that we provide alongside our custody, the AI innovations that we're making on behalf of clients, the advice and consulting support that we provide to clients, which is unique and differentiated.

items.text: Schwab CEO Wurster describes Schwab's job as providing a platform and a support ecosystem that helps advisors support their clients and helps their firm thrive.
items.quote: Our job and our role is to provide a platform and a support ecosystem that helps you support your clients and helps your firm thrive.

items.text: A Schwab spokesperson states the firm is focused on creating long-term value and access for advisors, bringing together custody, trading, banking, lending, wealth management, workplace and retail investing at scale and value with the best client service.
items.quote: Few firms can bring together custody, trading, banking, lending, wealth management, workplace and retail investing at Schwab's scale and value - with the best client service, year after year.

cells.reason: Multiple passages state how Schwab describes its value proposition to independent advisors, including its platform, ecosystem, scale, breadth of capabilities, and helping advisors grow, compete and succeed.
